title: GLM-5.3
summary: Full GLM 5.3 on g6, a from-scratch CUDA engine with no vLLM, PyTorch or NCCL at serve time. Up to 8 requests decode at once at TP=4, with DFlash2 speculative decoding for a request that runs alone, pair-owner QO prefill attention and context-parallel KV.

configs.label: TP=4

quality.name: Exactness
quality.value: each request byte-identical to running alone

configs.notes: RigMark 1.0.0, reasoning_effort low, GPU clocks capped at 2200 MHz.

configs.label: TP=6
configs.notes: One request at a time. Prose decode with MTP k=2 at temperature 0.7, one test window on one cluster; not RigMark.
